title: Stabilization and product-ideal annihilation for shrinking support
statement:
Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a nonzero commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], complete for its maximal-ideal topology [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $I\subsetneq A$ be an ideal, $M$ a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and $s,d\geq0$ integers. Work in the ordinary module derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $\Gamma_K(N)=\{x\in N:K^r x=0	ext{ for some }r\geq1\}$, write $R\Gamma_K$ for its right derived functor, and put $H_K^i(N)=H^i(R\Gamma_K(N[0]))$ [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor]. For $L\in D(A)$ use the functorial derived completion $F_I(L)=R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(L\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A/I^n)$, with K-flat tensor resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex] and the mapping fibre of $1-\mathrm{shift}$ on termwise products for the derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit], and its canonical map $\eta_L:L	o F_I(L)$. Write $V(K)=\{\mathfrak p:K\subseteq\mathfrak p\}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Assume that every prime $\mathfrak p
otin V(I)$ with $V(\mathfrak p)\cap V(I)=\{\mathfrak m\}$ satisfies $\dim\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak p)\leq d$. For every prime $\mathfrak p
otin V(I)$ with $V(\mathfrak p)\cap V(I)
e\{\mathfrak m\}$, assume
$$\operatorname{depth}_{A_{\mathfrak p}}M_{\mathfrak p}\geq s\quad	ext{or}\quad\operatorname{depth}_{A_{\mathfrak p}}M_{\mathfrak p}+\dim\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak p)>d+s,$$
using regular-sequence depth [def-weil-pbc-depth], prime localization [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then there are an ideal $J_1$ with $V(J_1)\cap V(I)=\{\mathfrak m\}$ and an integer $t\geq1$ such that for every $J\subseteq J_1$ with $V(J)\cap V(I)=\{\mathfrak m\}$ and every $0\leq i\leq s$, the natural map $H_{J_1}^i(M)	o H_J^i(M)$ is an isomorphism and $(J_1I)^tH_J^i(M)=0$.
